title: Kept lender logs pile up for instance roots and groups that no longer exist
foundBy: session agent, checking the host for leftovers after the fix for SBX-046 had been through `make ci` four times

evidence.verified: go test ./internal/cli/ -run 'TestStaleLenderLogs|TestStoppingALender' -count=1: PASS. A 30 day old log under another root went with its emptied directories, a day old log of another group stayed, and the log just kept was there.

resolution: When a lender's log is kept, every kept log older than 14 days is removed across all roots and groups, with the directories that empties. The 6 directories the gate runs had left on this host were removed by hand.
details:
SBX-046 made the host keep a lender's log under `~/.cache/cs-sandbox/lender-logs/<root>/<group>/`, and keep the newest 20 in each group's directory. Nothing removes a directory whose instance root or group is gone. Four runs of `make ci` left 6 directories there, one for each throwaway root the smoke tests made. A host that runs the tests, or makes groups with generated names, grows that tree without limit.

To reproduce, run `make test-smoke` twice and list `~/.cache/cs-sandbox/lender-logs`.

The renewer's per-root directory under `~/.cache/cs-sandbox/renewer` has the same shape and had 5 stale roots on this host. It holds a pid file and a log and grows more slowly. It is not part of this record.

notes.text: The smoke tests still write kept logs into the real cache, because they set the instances root and not `CS_SANDBOX_HOME`. The sweep bounds that at 14 days of runs. Pointing the tests at a cache of their own would stop it at the source.
